resources.string: This company-owned device reports basic app and screen activity (which app is in the foreground, window changes and simple interaction flags) to your organisation\'s My Drive admin console. It does not record your screen, microphone, camera, location or keystrokes, and it never stores what you type into password fields.
This is a company-owned device. Accessibility monitoring is enabled by your organisation and is disclosed here before you turn it on.
Android only exposes app and window activity through the Accessibility service. The permission is used solely to record the activity categories listed below for your organisation\'s admin console.

Foreground app and screen changes, simple interaction flags (tap, focus, scroll) and, only when your organisation enables it, window text and notification events. Values typed into password fields are never collected or stored.
Your screen contents, microphone, camera, location, keystrokes or password values are not captured.
Android requires you to enable this yourself in Settings. My Drive cannot and will not enable it for you.
